name: 100xcontinuity
description: Session continuity for Claude Code: save artifacts and conversation records from a session into a durable store, and load them back by name in a later session. The store is a plain directory — typically one a sync client already watches, which is how it reaches the cloud — or an S3-compatible bucket. Content-addressed blobs and an append-only log, so two machines can write to one session inside a synced folder without conflict copies.
